w:r.w:t: AjoBI has four core features: Auth & AjoScore, Digital Ajo Groups, Savings Goals, and Simple Escrow. The backend is PHP (REST API), the frontend is React. Each developer owns a vertical — one person can work on Ajo Groups while another works on Savings Goals without touching the same files or endpoints.
services/ ← all API calls live here
Each feature folder is self-contained. Two developers never edit the same file at the same time if they own different features.

User A creates an escrow request, gets a payment link, shares it. User B pays via that link. Both parties confirm. Funds release automatically. No marketplace. No job matching. Just a link and two confirm buttons.
